local: Wou d'Rief laanscht d'Musel dofteg bléit,
english: Where Alzette winds through meadows fair,
Through rocky cliffs the Sauer flows,
Where vineyards bloom along the Moselle,
And heaven’s wine bestows.

local: Dat as onst Land, fir dat mir géif
Ons Heemechtsland dat mir sou déif
english: This is our land, for which we’d dare
All things here down below,
Our homeland, dear, so deeply loved,
Within our hearts we know.

local: Sou ouni Pronk an deire Glanz
english: Within her shady forest ring,
By peaceful watch kept still,
Without display or gilded gleam,
She smiles with gentle will;

local: Säi Vollek frou sech soë kann,
Wéi wunnt et sech sou heemlech dran,
english: Her people happy in their hearts,
No empty dreams they know:
How sweetly life is lived therein,
How good it is to go.

local: Gesank, Gesank vu Bierg an Dall
english: From hill to dale, the songs resound,
The earth that gave us birth;
Love echoes true in every breast,
A loyal, faithful mirth;

local: Fir, d'Hemecht ass keng Weis ze schéin;
All Wuert, dat vun er klénkt,
Gräift äis an d' Séil wéi Himmelstéin
english: For homeland, none can sing too fair,
Each word that speaks her name
Touches our souls like heavenly stones,
And sparks our eyes like flame.

local: O Du do uewen, deen seng Hand
english: O Thou on high, whose mighty hand
Guides nations near and far,
Protect our [[Luxembourgish]] land
From foreign yoke and war;

local: Du hues ons all als Kanner schon
english: Give unto us, as once of old,
The spirit of the free;
Let liberty’s bright, glorious sun
Shine ever o’er our plea.
